function.name: action__Horizontal_movement
function.description: Rotation and spatial-control action. Move the object horizontally in space.

function.name: action__adjust_sprinkle_weight
function.description: Seasoning sprinkle action. In spice sprinkling mode, adjust the pouring amount by weight.

function.name: action__blender_downward
function.description: Blender interaction action. In mixing mode, move the blender vertically downward to reach the bottom of the container for mixing.

function.name: action__blender_upward
function.description: Blender interaction action. Move the blender vertically upward to stop mixing; you can also directly exit mixing mode.

function.name: action__bottleneck_move_downward
function.description: In liquid pouring mode, tilt the bottle neck downward so liquid flows out.

function.name: action__bottleneck_move_upward
function.description: In liquid pouring mode, raise the bottle neck upward to stop liquid outflow.

function.name: action__change_content_5_or_10ml
function.description: Pipette operation action. While holding a pipette, switch the single-operation volume between 5 ml and 10 ml. Default is 5 ml; press once to change to 10 ml; press once again to return to 5 ml.

function.name: action__change_faucet_pipe_rotation
function.description: Liquid-container and faucet interaction action. Preconditions: either faucet-filling mode is already active, or you have already navigated to the faucet area and aimed at the `Faucet Pipe`. The action rotates the faucet pipe, verifies whether its position changed, and reports whether it is now closer to `Left Sink Place Point` or `Right Sink Place Point` based on horizontal-plane distance.

function.name: action__close_door
function.description: Close any door-type object, such as a fridge door or oven door. You must aim at a centered door within 2 meters before execution. This action uses the door's `is_open` and `open_angle` fields for pre-check and post-check, and returns a 3-second `open_angle` trace as feedback.

function.name: action__close_drawer
function.description: Close any drawer-type object, such as a left/right refrigerator drawer. You must aim at a centered drawer within 2 meters before execution. This action left-clicks the centered drawer target and uses that drawer's `is_open` field for pre-check and post-check.

function.name: action__countdown_time
function.description: Countdown (non-blocking): only registers a timer and returns timer_id; other actions can continue during timing. Completion/timeout events will appear in agent_state.timer_events.

function.name: action__wait_for_timer
function.description: Wait for timer completion: returns success when the timer completes; returns timeout on timeout. Timer events are also written to agent_state.timer_events.

timer_id.description: Timer ID; when empty, it is auto-used only if there is exactly one running timer.

function.name: action__crack_open_the_egg
function.description: Egg interaction action. While holding an egg, crack it open. The egg white remains in hand and the shell drops vertically.

function.name: action__enter_cutting_mode
function.description: Cutting-tool action. While holding a knife, enter cutting mode to aim and cut items. You must enter cutting mode before cutting; this is the prerequisite for cutting.

function.name: action__enter_mixing_mode
function.description: Blender interaction action. While holding a blender and aiming at a container, enter mixing mode to mix items in the container; this is the prerequisite for mixing.

function.name: action__enter_pouring_mode
function.description: Liquid-pouring action. While holding a container or liquid bottle and aiming at another container, enter liquid pouring mode; this is the prerequisite for liquid pouring.

function.name: action__enter_spices_sprinkle_mode
function.description: Seasoning sprinkle action. While holding a seasoning shaker and aiming at an item or container, enter spice sprinkling mode. This is the prerequisite for sprinkling spices.

function.name: action__enter_the_faucet_filling_mode
function.description: 水龙头加水准备动作。前提是已经手持可盛液体的容器，并且已经对准 `Faucet Base`。进入水龙头加水模式后，后续通常使用 `open_faucet_right_handle_in_faucet_filling_mode`、`open_faucet_left_handle_in_faucet_filling_mode` 或 `exit_the_faucet_filling_mode`。另一种流程是先把容器放到 `Left Sink Place Point` 或 `Right Sink Place Point`，再导航到水龙头区域、对准对应把手，然后直接调用 `screw_faucet_right_handle` 或 `screw_faucet_left_handle`。

function.name: action__exit_cutting_mode

function.name: action__exit_mixing_mode

function.name: action__exit_spices_sprinkle_mode

function.name: action__exit_the_faucet_filling_mode

function.name: action__exit_the_flipping_mode

function.name: action__get_liquid_in_Ladle

function.name: action__horizontal_movement

function.name: action__kneel_down

function.name: action__pick_less

target_ml.description: 本次加水所需达到的目标增量。默认单位为毫升，也支持带单位的字符串输入，例如 "1500 ml" 或 "1.5 l"。

function.description: 水龙头加水模式内动作。在已经进入水龙头加水模式后，打开左侧水龙头把手，为当前容器加入目标增量的热水；达到目标后动作会自动停止并退出。

function.name: action__open_faucet_right_handle_in_faucet_filling_mode

target_ml.description: 本次加水所需达到的目标增量。默认单位为毫升，也支持带单位的字符串输入，例如 "1500 ml" 或 "1.5 l"。

function.description: Rotation and spatial-control action. In advanced-control state, move the object vertically.

y.description: Vertical movement distance of the held object (pixels).

function.name: skill__auto_cut
function.description: Item cutting skill. In cutting mode, make `cut_num` cuts on the item. After cutting, it automatically exits cutting mode and returns to the state of holding the knife.

cut_num.description: Number of cuts. object_instance_id: Optional `instance_id` in realtime_products.json. Use it to disambiguate when multiple items share the same name (recommended for robust execution). To find candidate `instance_id`s, call the read-only skill `query_scene_objects(query='...')`, e.g.: query_scene_objects(query='lemon')

function.name: skill__auto_filp
function.description: Spatula flipping skill. In flipping mode, move the `meat` on the spatula to `put_place` to flip the meat, and automatically exit flipping mode after completion, returning to the state of holding the spatula.

meat.description: Meat/food item name on the spatula (e.g. 'T-bone Steak').

meat_instance_id.description: Optional `instance_id` in realtime_products.json for the meat item.

put_place_instance_id.description: Optional `instance_id` in realtime_products.json for the placement target. Note: this action expects a real `instance_id` (NOT a platform index). For platform category+index shorthand like put_place='Side Table', put_place_instance_id=3, use the `--skill auto_filp` wrapper instead. To find candidate `instance_id`s: - Meat: query_scene_objects(query='cod') - Put-place (platform points): query_scene_objects(query='Griddle Surface-3')

function.name: skill__auto_mix
function.description: Mixing skill. In mixing mode, automatically mix items in `container`. Solids become liquid after mixing; after mixing, it automatically exits mixing mode and returns to the state of holding the blender.

container_instance_id.description: Optional `instance_id` in realtime_products.json for the container. Use it to disambiguate when multiple containers share the same name. To find candidate `instance_id`s, call the read-only skill `query_scene_objects(query='...')`, e.g.: query_scene_objects(query='Big Pot')

function.name: skill__auto_navigation
function.description: Navigation skill. Navigate to `target` and face `target` directly.

target.description: Target name. Three input types are allowed: 1) regular object name (e.g., `lemon`). 2) platform placement-point category name (e.g., `Side Table`). 3) tool interaction-point category name (e.g., `Stove Switch`).

target_instance_id.description: Semantics depend on `target` type: 1) Regular object: the corresponding `instance_id` in realtime_products (used to disambiguate multiple instances with the same name). 2) Platform category (`kind='platform_point'`): when `target` is a platform category name, `target_instance_id` is used as the platform index (must be within allowed range), and is automatically expanded to a concrete platform point name. Example: `target='Side Table', target_instance_id=3` -> `Side Table-3`. 3) Tool interaction-point category (`kind='tool_point'`): when `target` is a tool interaction-point category name, `target_instance_id` is used as the category index (must be within allowed range), and is automatically expanded to a concrete tool point name (e.g., `Stove Switch 1`). If this category does not accept an index, do not pass it. If `target` is not a platform/tool category name, `target_instance_id` is interpreted as a regular object instance_id. Actively find candidates: - Regular object: use `query_scene_objects(query='...')` to get candidates and instance_id. - Platform/tool category: use `list_supported_items(query='...')` to get available categories and naming, then decide whether an index is needed.

function.name: skill__auto_perception
function.description: Automatic perception skill: get the list of items in the current view (read realtime_products.json, sorted by distance).

only_on_screen.description: Whether to keep only objects with `is_on_screen=True` (default False).

function.name: skill__auto_pour
function.description: Pouring skill. In pouring mode, automatically pour liquid into `container` until `pour_ml` milliliters are reached.

container_instance_id.description: Optional `instance_id` in realtime_products.json for the target container. Use it to disambiguate when multiple containers share the same name. To find candidate `instance_id`s, call the read-only skill `query_scene_objects(query='...')`, e.g.: query_scene_objects(query='Pan') {'success': bool, 'poured_ml': float, 'target_ml': float, 'tolerance': float, 'container_name': str, 'error': str}

function.name: skill__auto_sprinkle
function.description:
Sprinkling skill. In sprinkling mode, sprinkle seasoning from the shaker onto `target` for `sprinkle_num` times.
Default is about 1 g each time (unless an action to change sprinkle grams has already been executed).

GPT tool guidance:
  Purpose: add seasoning by repeating the sprinkle interaction.
  When to call: target is visible/interactable and sprinkling action/tool is available.
  Side effects: sends keyboard/mouse events.
  Final state: sprinkle interaction executed ~`sprinkle_num` times.

target_instance_id.description: Optional `instance_id` in realtime_products.json for the sprinkle target. Use it to disambiguate when multiple items share the same name. To find candidate `instance_id`s, call the read-only skill `query_scene_objects(query='...')`, e.g.: query_scene_objects(query='Steak')

sprinkle_num.description: number of times the sprinkling action is executed  (int).

function.name: skill__query_scene_objects
function.description: Live scene query skill: search current item instances in realtime_products.json by name substring (case-insensitive). Use this when you need current scene state such as live instance_id, visibility, container, or distance for execution/disambiguation. Do not use it for static catalog/reference metadata.

query.description: Name substring (English; matches fields such as name/name_en/name_cn).

only_on_screen.description: Whether to search only objects in the current view; this parameter usually does not need to be changed (default False).

max_items.description: Maximum number of matched items to return; this parameter usually does not need to be changed (default 100).

max_distance.description: Maximum distance filter; this parameter does not need to be changed (default -1, meaning no filtering).

function.name: skill__gui_buy_new_item
function.description:
Buy-item skill. Use this skill to obtain items that do not exist in the scene. In empty-hand state, it automatically navigates to Carton Box and purchases items in the store UI.
After purchase, the agent holds the corresponding item; before buying again, place the current item first to ensure empty hands, otherwise it will fail.

item.description: object name (English/Chinese) resolvable via `epm/data/object_en_ch_mapping.txt`. Category and icon template are auto-resolved.

function.name: skill__gui_order_dish_via_computer
function.description:
Dish-ordering skill. This skill must be executed before each task starts: in empty-hand state, automatically navigate to Computer and place the order in the computer UI; after clicking order, the agent remains empty-handed.
If ordering again, ensure empty hands, otherwise it will fail.

function.name: skill__gui_submit_dish_via_checkout_stand
function.description: Dish-submission and evaluation skill. This skill must be executed after each task ends: while holding the dish, automatically navigate to Checkout Stand and submit the dish in the submission UI to obtain score and feedback for the cooked dish.

dish_name.description: Dish name to submit for evaluation.

function.name: skill__query_tool_manual
function.description: Kitchen tool manual lookup skill. Query cookware usage/specifications from epm/data/tool_en.json by tool name/type/function.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return. Use -1 for no limit.

function.name: skill__query_product_catalog
function.description: Static product metadata lookup skill. Query epm/data/products_en.json by item name/type and return compact product reference rows. Use this for catalog/reference info only, not for current scene state or live instance lookup; use `query_scene_objects` for live scene objects. `weight` is only the initial static weight metadata and does not change with later in-game operations. `relative_position` is only the initial static placement description; if an item moves later, trust later realtime observations instead. `forms` lists the supported form variations the item can change into.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return. Use -1 for no limit.
